title: Reincarnation, recurring dreams and purported past-life memories: evidence update
evidence_boundary: Reports and statistical patterns are established as observations in the cited datasets; reincarnation and transferred memory are not established mechanisms.

sources.citation: Sadeghi, Pehlivanova and Cozzolino (2026), A Large-Scale Analysis of Temporal Patterns in Children's Purported Past-Life Memories
sources.claim_scope: An association was reported between unexpectedness of death and a shorter interval before the child's birth.
sources.retrieval_result: DOI verified; publisher access may be restricted

sources.citation: Cozzolino et al. (2025), Xenoglossy in Children's Past-Life Memory Cases
sources.claim_scope: The authors reported associations between xenoglossy coding and selected case characteristics.
limitations: independent linguistic and source verification required
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0; citation and summary used

sources.citation: Pehlivanova et al. (2024), Impact of children's purported past-life memories: a follow-up investigation of American cases
sources.sample: 23 American adults first interviewed as children
sources.claim_scope: The study examined later wellbeing and perceived impact, not historical accuracy of childhood statements.
sources.rights: CC BY; citation and summary used

sources.citation: Hudachek and Wamsley (2023), The relationship between dream content and memory consolidation: a meta-analysis
sources.claim_scope: Task-related dream content was associated with later memory performance, supporting an ordinary memory-processing pathway.
limitations: does not address every recurrent dream
does not test purported past-life identity

sources.citation: University of Virginia Division of Perceptual Studies, Concerns about Hypnotic Regression
sources.claim_scope: Regression hypnosis is not used by the programme for case investigation; vividness or therapeutic benefit does not authenticate historical memory.
limitations: does not adjudicate every spontaneous report

alternative_explanations_to_test: trauma, emotion and repeated waking concerns
method_notes: Record exact spontaneous statements before identifying or contacting a proposed previous family.
Use blinded matching and controlled recognition where possible.
Publish negative outcomes and seek independent replication.
Do not treat an unavailable source as false and do not silently replace original URLs.
